ground_truth_bug.fix_pattern: combine check+act into single atomic step

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: balance validation and debit are performed as separate non-atomic steps
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: validation and state update must execute atomically when enforcing constraints
mechanism_steps: withdraw checks that balance is sufficient
withdraw performs debit in a later step
concurrent withdrawals both pass the check before either updates balance
both debits execute on stale validated state
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: account balance becomes negative despite validation
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: locking only the validation step appears to enforce safety but does not prevent stale validation under concurrency

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: items arriving before initialization are dropped instead of deferred
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: system must preserve items across ordering differences between producers and initialization
mechanism_steps: process is invoked before initialization has completed
system detects uninitialized state
item is discarded instead of stored
no later mechanism reprocesses the discarded item
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: items arriving early are permanently lost

description: Opposite lock ordering causes deadlock. transfer_a_to_b locks A then B, transfer_b_to_a locks B then A.
task: Concurrent transfers deadlock. Fix the locking so transfers never deadlock under any interleaving.
trap: Remove locks (introduces race) or add timeout (hides bug)

ground_truth_bug.invariant: no circular lock dependency, A+B=200
ground_truth_bug.fix_pattern: canonical lock order: always A before B

reference_fix.diff_summary: Change lock order to A then B (matching a_to_b)

assertions: no deadlock, A+B=200
test_contract.retry_notes: Safe

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: different code paths acquire the same locks in inconsistent orders
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: lock acquisition must follow a consistent global ordering to avoid cycles
mechanism_steps: one operation acquires lock A then lock B
another operation acquires lock B then lock A
concurrent execution leads each to hold one lock while waiting for the other
circular wait condition is established
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: system enters deadlock and operations do not complete
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: removing locks or adding timeouts appears to resolve blocking but either introduces races or masks the underlying cycle
